title: Observability-to-Action Receipt
description: Receipt for agentic SRE workflows that move from telemetry observation to proposed or executed action. Distinguishes telemetry, hypothesis, recommendation, approval, execution, and validation.

incident_id.description: Incident identifier this receipt relates to

telemetry_source.description: Source of telemetry (e.g. prometheus, datadog, cloudwatch, local-logs)

query_path.description: Query or path used to retrieve telemetry data

time_window.description: Time window of the telemetry observation

agent_hypothesis.description: Agent's hypothesis about the cause or nature of the incident

evidence_refs.description: References to evidence (logs, metrics, screenshots, bus receipts). Ephemeral sources must be marked.

authority_required.description: Whether human authority is required before executing the action

human_approval_status.description: Human approval status for the proposed action

human_approval_by.description: Identity of the human who approved/rejected (if applicable)

executed_action.description: Action that was actually executed (if any)

execution_actor.description: Who or what executed the action (agent, human, automated-system)

rollback_route.description: Rollback route for the executed action (required if action was executed)

mode.description: Receipt mode — advisory only, or human-approved execution

redacted.description: Whether sensitive logs/secrets have been redacted before persistence

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the receipt content (excluding the hash field itself)
